mapper.select: SELECT category as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM analysis_result GROUP BY category
SELECT sentiment as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM analysis_result GROUP BY sentiment
SELECT DATE(analyzed_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM analysis_result WHERE analyzed_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(analyzed_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT CONCAT(LPAD(HOUR(analyzed_at), 2, '0'), ':00') as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM analysis_result WHERE DATE(analyzed_at) = CURDATE() GROUP BY HOUR(analyzed_at) ORDER BY HOUR(analyzed_at)
SELECT keyword as name, SUM(count) as value FROM hot_topic WHERE stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
